title: What Can $11 Million Buy? — proportional vertical bars
description: Story format. Two bottom-aligned columns drawn to honest scale: the red opposing column ($11,077,173) towers over a green supporting bar ($323,426) only 29px tall.
alt_text: Vertical story graphic titled “What Can $11 Million Buy?” with a tagline about a people-powered movement. A tall red column labeled $11,077,173 OPPOSING towers over a very short green bar labeled $323,426 SUPPORTING, drawn to true scale.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
